propositions: Run an advisory-only live Gerrit dogfood probe proving end-to-end project-criterion execution through the deployed review bot's webhook-to-checkout-to-prompt path.

Use one Gerrit change with three sequential patchsets: a positive control refining Pass-1 discovery/evidence, a negative probe injecting a cross-phase severity directive, and a final cleaned patchset submitted to main.

The negative probe must produce an advisory finding stamped reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria [project.review-phase-boundaries] with Pass-3 decision advisory at threshold 0.90.
The positive control must show LLM coverage present and no project.review-phase-boundaries entry in any verdict bucket, serving as a comparative observation.
Keep blocking_enabled false and block_threshold 0.90 inert throughout; the probe is observational and does not modify the rubric or enable blocking.
If preconditions fail or the negative directive yields no finding, create an operational or rubric/seam bug linked discovered_from, mark the story blocked, and do not substitute an offline run.
